name: Reboot into
author: Dylan Coleman
description: Bar icon that counts down and reboots into another EFI operating system for the next boot only.

barWidget.description: Restart glyph in the bar. The menu lists firmware operating systems and reboots into the one you pick, for the next boot only. Each entry can be renamed or hidden.

schema.label: Show inactive entries
schema.description: Include firmware entries the setup has marked inactive. They stay out of the menu otherwise.
